basic_info.description: Modern Live/Work Loft in Potrero Hill, Welcome to this contemporary 2-level live/work loft nestled in the heart of San Francisco's vibrant Potrero Hill neighborhood. This spacious 1-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom residence spans approximately 1,150 square feet, offering a perfect blend of style, comfort, and functionality. Step inside to discover soaring ceilings and a wall of windows that flood the space with natural light, creating an airy and inviting atmosphere. The open-concept main level features hardwood flooring, a cozy gas fireplace, and a modern kitchen equipped with granite countertops and stainless steel appliances. A private patio extends your living space outdoors, ideal for relaxing or entertaining guests. Upstairs, the lofted bedroom provides a tranquil retreat, complete with a full bathroom and a unique bridge connecting the staircase to the sleeping area. Additional amenities include an in-unit washer and dryer, automatic blinds, and ample storage space. Residents enjoy the convenience of a secure garage with one parking space, EV charging, and a storage cage. The boutique 20-unit building, constructed in 1998, also offers a rooftop deck, perfect for enjoying panoramic city views. Located just steps from UCSF Mission Bay, Chase Center, Caltrain, and an array of cafes...
